info.name: Civix API - Actor & Resource Collection
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for Civix API. Grouped by Actor / Role (Citizen, Technician, Dispatcher, Department Manager, City Admin, Super Admin) and nested by Resources with sample payloads, query parameters, route variables, and authentication tokens.

item.name: 00. Authentication & Public Discovery
item.description: Registration, login, password recovery, session tokens, and public directory discovery APIs.

request.description: Registers a new citizen with default CITIZEN role and sends verification email OTP.

Authenticates any role (Citizen, Staff, Admin) and returns accessToken and refreshToken.
Exchanges refreshToken cookie for a fresh JWT accessToken.
Sign in or register citizen using Google Identity Services ID token.
Sends a password reset OTP to the registered email address.
Resets user password with valid OTP and sets new password.
Clears refresh token and invalidates active session.
Retrieves authenticated user ID, email, roles, and status.

item.name: 01. Citizen
item.description: APIs exclusive to registered citizens for submitting complaints, tracking requests, giving feedback, and managing their profile.

request.description: Citizen submits a new service request complaint with location coordinates.

Fetches citizen user profile, trust level, and account details.
Updates citizen personal profile and NID verification number.

item.name: 02. Technician
item.description: Field technician APIs for managing assignments, work order lifecycles, submitting on-site updates, and filing resolutions.

request.description: Real-time dashboard for technician: active work orders, assignments pending acceptance, and workload.

Technician accepts or rejects assignment (status: ACCEPTED or REJECTED).
Lists all work orders where the technician is the current assignee.
Full work order details, issue description, location, and past updates.
Transitions work order status: IN_PROGRESS, PENDING_VERIFICATION, etc.

item.name: Quick Action Work Order (START / PAUSE / RESUME)

request.description: Executes quick lifecycle action: START, PAUSE, or RESUME.
Logs field work update with status: ON_SITE, PROGRESS, BLOCKED, DELAYED, or COMPLETED.
Technician files completed resolution summary for verification by dispatchers.
Uploads photos taken during on-site inspection or active repair work.
Uploads photos showing completed, restored conditions.

item.description: Department triage and dispatch staff APIs for evaluating incoming service requests, routing issues, assigning crews, and verifying resolutions.
